# Naviamp v2.8.0 — Cast music from Android

Naviamp 2.8.0 adds Google Cast playback from Android phones and tablets. It also lets Naviamp Connect pair across Tailnets by entering a device address, adds API-key connections for compatible OpenSubsonic servers, and brings new playback and library controls.

## Highlights

- Send online music from Android to a Google Cast receiver, control playback from the phone, and return to local listening at the current position.
- Pair Naviamp Connect devices across Tailnets with a manual address while retaining secure pairing and trusted reconnects.
- Use an OpenSubsonic API key with a compatible Navidrome server without entering an account password.

## Features

- Add Google Cast playback from Android. The phone serves authenticated online tracks and artwork to a receiver on a reachable local network; Cast controls, queue advancement, progress, and handoff back to local playback work from Now Playing. ([Issue #147](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/147), [PR #149](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/149))
- Add manual address entry for Naviamp Connect, including secure pairing and trusted reconnect at a changed address across a Tailnet. ([Issue #154](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/154), [PR #164](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/164))
- Add an explicit OpenSubsonic API-key connection option for compatible Navidrome servers while retaining password and token authentication for older servers. ([Issue #157](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/157), [PR #165](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/165))
- Swipe horizontally on the visualizer to move to the next or previous available visualizer. ([Issue #20](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/20), [PR #167](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/167))

## Improvements

- Optionally replace lower-quality cached audio with the quality selected for Wi-Fi or a wired network when that track is encountered again. The setting is off by default. ([Issue #130](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/130), [PR #133](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/133))
- Make the DJ editor easier to navigate and show the active playlist in Now Playing. ([Issue #143](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/143), [PR #163](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/163); [Issue #95](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/95), [PR #152](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/152))

## Bug fixes

- Fall back to password authentication when a Subsonic server rejects token authentication with error 41. ([Issue #158](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/158), [PR #161](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/161))
- Make the Space key pause as well as start playback on macOS and Windows. ([Issue #155](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/155), [PR #156](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/156))
- Display HTML entities correctly in artist and album descriptions without changing literal text. ([Issue #144](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/144), [PR #148](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/148))

## Upgrade notes

- No special upgrade steps are required. Existing saved connections keep their authentication method.
- A Navidrome server must support the OpenSubsonic API-key extension to use the new key connection option. Other connections continue to work as before.
- Update both ends of a Naviamp Connect session to use manual address pairing and reconnect.

## Known issues

- Initial Google Cast support is an Android sender for online provider media on a stable, reachable local network. Downloaded or offline Cast, sender-side lyrics and audio effects, extended interruption recovery, and iOS or desktop senders are planned for a later revision. ([Follow-up #168](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/168))
- OpenSubsonic API-key interoperability has not yet been checked against a live compatible Navidrome server; the server extension is still pending upstream. Existing password and token connections are unaffected. ([Issue #157](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/157), [PR #165](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/165))
- Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta. The iOS artifact is an unsigned preview; Windows and macOS packages are not publisher-signed.
